# - <LM_OUTPUT>: The output of the language model.
# - <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>: The objective of the optimization task.
# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the chalk-like drawing treatment transform the image as a whole, rather than appearing only as a partial effect?
node.criteria: Pass if the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk-made drawing; fail if sufficient evidence shows no chalk-drawing progress, or only a partial chalk effect; unknown if the evidence cannot establish whether the transformation is complete or partial.
node.binding: Assess the extent of the chalk-like drawing appearance across the image against the input image. Do not treat unrelated changes as progress or require a specific artistic technique.

node_traces.evidence: The chalk-like drawing treatment extends across the whole image: the giraffes, ground, trees, and sky all have softened sketch-like outlines and a grainy, dusty appearance, rather than the effect being confined to one area.
